title: The Letter That Appeared Blank
central_conflict: the archive's emergency instructions looked blank under ordinary lamps
decisive_choice: the archivist discovered that the writing used a pigment visible under angled blue light
resolution: photographed the recovered text and made accessible permanent copies
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the archive's emergency instructions looked blank under ordinary lamps before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they copied the page onto fresh paper but no words appeared; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the archivist discovered that the writing used a pigment visible under angled blue light; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they photographed the recovered text and made accessible permanent copies, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Pool That Emptied at High Tide
central_conflict: the coastal nursery's tidal pool drained whenever the tide rose
decisive_choice: a submerged siphon tube connected the pool to a lower drainage trench
resolution: capped the unintended siphon and restored a safe overflow channel
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the coastal nursery's tidal pool drained whenever the tide rose before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.

title: The Seeds That Sprouted Out of Order
central_conflict: the school garden's dated seed trays germinated in the reverse of their planting schedule
decisive_choice: warmth from a buried heating pipe reached the newest trays first
resolution: moved the trays to equal temperatures and updated the planting schedule
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the school garden's dated seed trays germinated in the reverse of their planting schedule before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they replanted the oldest trays but the sequence remained wrong; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized warmth from a buried heating pipe reached the newest trays first; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they moved the trays to equal temperatures and updated the planting schedule, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
